title: UEFA Backs France's Philippe Diallo to Challenge Infantino for FIFA Presidency
detail: Ahead of the Nov 18 nomination deadline, UEFA's national associations unanimously backed French federation president Philippe Diallo to stand against Gianni Infantino in the FIFA presidential election at the Congress in Rabat on March 18, 2027. Arsène Wenger, reportedly UEFA's first choice, made clear he would not run. The FFF had withdrawn support for Infantino in September after the failed World Cup stake-sale plan. Kozo Tashima is also reported as a challenger; Infantino retains support from CONMEBOL and CAF.

media.caption: UEFA backs Diallo to challenge Infantino
